text: requests go shared helpers utils.R. Never call httr2/httr directly wrapper. Wrappers build base URL + named query list hand toa_api_call(): toa_api_call(url, query) – builds request, performs , returns parsed JSON. toa_api_headers(url, query) – , returns requests_remaining/requests_used quota data.frame (used toa_requests()). NULL query values dropped automatically httr2::req_url_query(), optional parameters (bookmakers = NULL, event_ids = NULL, days_from = NULL) can threaded unconditionally – never build query list conditionally. Booleans must lowercased strings: includeRotationNumbers = (isTRUE(x)) "true" else NULL.
code: toa_function <- function(sport_key, regions = 'us', markets = 'h2h', date_format = 'iso'){   base_url <- glue::glue('https://api.the-odds-api.com/v4/sports/{sport_key}/odds')   query_params <- list(     apiKey      = as.character(toa_key()),     regions     = regions,     markets     = markets,     dateFormat  = date_format   )    odds <- data.frame()   # initialize return var BEFORE tryCatch (see below)    tryCatch(     expr = {       odds <- toa_api_call(base_url, query = query_params) %>%         # ... parse ...         make_toa_data("Sports Odds data from the-odds-api.com", Sys.time())     },     error = function(e) {       cli::cli_alert_danger("{Sys.time()}: Invalid arguments or no data available for {sport_key}!")       cli::cli_alert_danger("Error:\n{e}")     },     warning = function(w) {       cli::cli_alert_warning("{Sys.time()}: Warning:\n{w}")     },     finally = {}   )   return(odds) }

text: Odds API returns three usage headers every response: x-requests-remaining, x-requests-used, x-requests-last. toa_api_request() caches package-local .oddsapiR environment via .toa_store_quota(). : Attached attributes (oddsapiR_requests_remaining/_used/_last) every returned tibble make_toa_data() (dplyr/tidyr transforms strip attributes intermediate parse, attached end, raw response). Echoed oddsapiR_data tibble printed (print.oddsapiR_data). Exposed via exported toa_quota() accessor (last call’s usage session). adding wrapper, nothing special – routing toa_api_call() + make_toa_data() wires quota capture automatically. Two usage accessors, different cost: toa_requests() makes fresh (free) call /v4/sports returns 2-column tibble (requests_remaining, requests_used); toa_quota() reads session-cached values network round-trip returns 3 columns (adds requests_last, cost recent call), NULL call made yet session.

code: # Work with h2h (moneyline) only h2h <- nba_odds %>%   filter(market_key == "h2h")  # Implied probability per outcome, before removing vig h2h_prob <- h2h %>%   group_by(id, bookmaker_key) %>%   mutate(     implied_prob_raw = 1 / outcomes_price,     total_overround  = sum(implied_prob_raw),     # Remove vig: normalise so probs sum to 1     implied_prob_fair = implied_prob_raw / total_overround   ) %>%   ungroup()  h2h_prob %>%   select(home_team, away_team, bookmaker, outcomes_name,          outcomes_price, implied_prob_raw, implied_prob_fair) %>%   head(6) # home_team           away_team       bookmaker   outcomes_name       price  raw_prob  fair_prob # Los Angeles Lakers  Boston Celtics  DraftKings  Los Angeles Lakers  2.05   0.488     0.490 # Los Angeles Lakers  Boston Celtics  DraftKings  Boston Celtics      1.90   0.526     0.510 # Los Angeles Lakers  Boston Celtics  FanDuel     Los Angeles Lakers  2.00   0.500     0.499 # Los Angeles Lakers  Boston Celtics  FanDuel     Boston Celtics      1.87   0.535     0.501

code: # Build a 6-snapshot series for a specific event event_id   <- "93af4b300a4c0dded909234ea32e9abd" start_date <- "2024-01-13T12:00:00Z" n_snapshots <- 6  snapshots <- list() current_date <- start_date  for (i in seq_len(n_snapshots)) {   snap <- toa_event_odds_history(     sport_key   = "basketball_nba",     event_id    = event_id,     date        = current_date,     regions     = "us",     markets     = "spreads",     odds_format = "decimal",     date_format = "iso"   )    if (nrow(snap) == 0) break    snapshots[[i]] <- snap   current_date   <- snap$next_timestamp[[1]]    # Be kind to the API rate limit   Sys.sleep(0.5) }  line_movement <- bind_rows(snapshots) %>%   filter(market_key == "spreads", bookmaker_key == "draftkings") %>%   select(timestamp, home_team, away_team, outcomes_name,          outcomes_price, outcomes_point)  line_movement # timestamp                 home_team           away_team       outcomes_name       price  point # 2024-01-13T12:00:00Z      Los Angeles Lakers  Boston Celtics  Los Angeles Lakers  1.91   -4.5 # 2024-01-13T17:00:00Z      Los Angeles Lakers  Boston Celtics  Los Angeles Lakers  1.91   -5.0 # 2024-01-14T00:00:00Z      Los Angeles Lakers  Boston Celtics  Los Angeles Lakers  1.95   -5.5 # ...
